title: 1RB0RE_0LC1LE_0RD1LD_1RA1LF_1LC0RA_0LB---: five phase rules for any prefix; no halt in 10<sup>17610</sup> steps in Lean
text: Five phase rules, proved in Lean for any tape left of the counter, cover all but 17 of the first 1,000,000 phases. Those 17 cycle ends, of 9 kinds, are proved one by one. Lean's kernel runs the resulting map 100,000 phases from blank tape, so the machine does not halt in its first 10<sup>17610</sup> steps; with native_decide the map runs 1,000,000 phases (10<sup>176092</sup> steps).
